tools.name: search_conferences
tools.description: Use this to find conferences and trade shows by topic, place, year or month, for example fintech conferences in 2027 or events in Las Vegas in March. Returns matching events, largest company lists first, with dates, city and country, the event's own website, how many sponsors and exhibitors are listed, and the conferencedatabase.com page for each. With no year or month it returns upcoming events only.

topic.description: Industry or subject, such as fintech, healthcare, AI, cybersecurity, retail or manufacturing. Leave out for all topics.

location.description: A city, country or region, such as Las Vegas, Germany or Europe.

limit.description: How many events to return, default 10, at most 25.

tools.name: get_conference
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one specific conference or trade show: when and where it is, who organizes it, what its sponsorship packages cost as the organizer publishes them, how many sponsors and exhibitors are listed, and which well-known companies are there. Takes the event name or its conferencedatabase.com slug.

name_or_slug.description: A conference name such as "NAB Show" or "Money20/20", or its conferencedatabase.com slug such as "nab-show". A year in the name is ignored.

tools.name: get_conference_sponsors
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which companies sponsor or exhibit at a specific conference. Returns company names, websites, role (sponsor, partner, media partner or exhibitor) and sponsorship level for one edition, ordered by how many conferences each company is listed at. Returns up to 50 companies per call with the total count; use offset to read further.

name_or_slug.description: A conference name such as "NAB Show" or "Money20/20", or its conferencedatabase.com slug such as "nab-show". A year in the name is ignored.

role.description: Only companies with this role. Leave out for all roles.

year.description: Edition year. Leave out for the current or next edition.

limit.description: Companies to return, default 25, at most 50.

offset.description: Companies to skip, to read the next page.

tools.name: get_company_conferences
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which conferences or trade shows a company sponsors or exhibits at, or where it will be next. Takes a company name or website domain, such as salesforce.com. Returns the events with year, dates, location and the company's role at each, newest first, up to 50 with the total count, plus the company's page on conferencedatabase.com.

company_or_domain.description: A company name such as "Salesforce" or its website domain such as "salesforce.com".

upcoming_only.description: Only events that have not happened yet.

tools.name: find_sponsors_for_event
tools.description: Use this when someone organizing a conference, trade show or event wants companies that might sponsor or exhibit at it. Takes their event (a name or website, if it is in the database) and/or a topic and a place. Returns the companies listed at the most similar conferences, with how many of those conferences each was at, how many as a sponsor or partner, and a few of the events, plus the conferences compared. Company-level only.

event.description: The organizer's own conference or one like it: a name such as "Money20/20" or a website such as money2020.com.

topic.description: Industry or subject of the event, such as fintech, healthcare, AI or retail. Leave out to use the named event's industry.

location.description: A city, country or region, such as Chicago, Germany or Europe. Leave out for anywhere.

limit.description: Companies to return, default 25, at most 50.
